messages:
Rowan: Hypothetical time! If you could adopt exactly ONE fictional pet (mythical, sci-fi, cartoon, whatever), what would you pick and why? :sparkles: :paw_prints:
Talia: A baby dragon. Low-maintenance as long as you have a moat and a very big cereal bowl. :dragon:
Mark: A really small, polite velociraptor who only attacks contracts that read like bad prose. :stegosaurus: (Also image of tiny raptor in tie)
Jun: A robotic corgi that fetches your lost headphones and also charges your phone. Practical and adorable. :robot_face: :dog:
Avery: A pocket-sized cloud that rains only cold brew on demand. Hydration + caffeine. :cloud: :coffee:
Rowan: @Talia the moat is budget-sensitive but I see the aesthetic. @Jun that corgi is the lie I believe in.
Talia: Bonus: dragon sing-along nights. Ill teach it to hum the company jingle.
Mark: Follow-up: whats the one rule youd set for your pet?
Jun: No bringing other robots home unannounced. Also, no chewing on GPUs.
Avery: Only rain cold brew during meetings with fewer than 6 people. Respect the plants.
SnackBot: Reminder: pets are allowed in the office only during designated "Bring Your Mythical Pet" days and must be registered with People Ops. :paw_prints:
Rowan: Poll (totally scientific): Dragon, Tiny Raptor, Robo-Corgi, Coffee Cloud, Other. Reply with your pick.
Talia: Dragon
Mark: Tiny Raptor (I will defend this choice)
Jun: Robo-Corgi
Avery: Coffee Cloud
Rowan: Other (Id pick a shape-shifting soot sprite that folds laundry)
Talia: Soot sprites are practical and chaos-adjacent, approve.
Mark: We need a "Bring Your Mythical Pet" photo wall if this gets enough interest.
Jun: Event idea logged: "Mythical Pet Day" next Tuesday 2pm. Tiny waiver required.
SnackBot: Event added to #calendar. Please submit fantasy pet photos to #random-photos.
Rowan: Conclusion: very important discussion. Expect follow-ups and adorable doodles.
